title: CAF-Gen：一种用于丰富论证结构的多智能体系统
summary: CAF-Gen是一个自动化多智能体框架，通过迭代的创建者-审查者流程，将浅层论证结构丰富为符合Carneades论证框架（CAF）的模型。实验表明，该多智能体协作能克服单次生成模型的局限性，提高数据质量并与原始标注高度对齐。
summary_en: CAF-Gen is an automated multi-agent framework that enriches shallow argument structures into CAF-compliant models via an iterative Creator-Reviewer pipeline. Experiments show that this multi-agent collaboration overcomes limitations of single-pass generation, improving data quality and achieving strong alignment with original annotations.
